cases.rationale: The foreground standing human and the people riding in the canal craft are actual people; the long narrow hulls on the water identify actual boats. The overhead fabric is flags and a building awning, without umbrella structure or flying-kite identity. The trees are unpotted; distant shop merchandise supplies no identifiable bottle or other defined object. I considered every frozen definition across the entire original crop; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

Hanging and piled curved yellow fruit are bananas. The round orange fruit at lower left is identifiable as oranges; the red and yellow-green round fruit at lower right includes apples. The two blue open scale pans have actual bowl bodies and rims. The fruit rests on a shop counter, not an identifiable dining table, and the canopy is an awning rather than an umbrella. Every frozen definition was considered on the original crop; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

An orange-and-white actual cat sits beside a striped handled drinking mug, desktop keyboard, and white mouse. The large left display is a standalone monitor, not a laptop. Bound volumes with visible spines occupy the shelving. The black appliance behind the desk is a printer, not a microwave or oven; the surface is a computer work desk rather than a dining table. Other small desk items do not identify phones or remotes. Every frozen definition was considered on the original crop; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

A human face fills the crop, with a turquoise toothbrush whose narrow handle and bristled head contact the mouth. The cap and sunglasses are neither an electronic device nor any other defined category. Snow and trees in the background provide no visible snowboard or potted plant. Every frozen definition was considered over the entire original crop; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

Visible diners are people. The restaurant has eating tables, separate dining chairs, and a long upholstered booth bench at left. Tabletop drinking cups and narrow-neck condiment bottles are identifiable. The left seating is a booth bench rather than a separate sofa. Small utensils partly hidden by napkins and table settings lack enough head/blade detail to resolve fork, knife, or spoon, so categories 42, 43, and 44 remain unclear. Foreground black rectangles are menu-like panels, without laptop or monitor structure. Every frozen definition was explicitly considered on the original crop.

The face, hand, and body belong to an actual person. The held food has two round bread pieces surrounding a substantial filling, identifying a sandwich/burger portion rather than plain bread, a doughnut, or cake. The blue material is clothing and the white background is wall siding. Every frozen definition was considered on the original crop; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

Actual elephants with trunks carry visible human riders, and a person walks beside the foreground elephant. The elevated round red canopies are supported parasols, identifying umbrellas. A small passenger car is visible beyond the path at right. The riding equipment and decorative cloth do not identify an independent chair, bench, backpack, or handbag; surrounding vegetation has no pot context. Every frozen definition was considered on the original crop; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

This kitchen counter contains small narrow-neck glass bottles at left, a white drinking cup in front of the coffee maker, and a white fluted open bowl at lower left. The utensil storage includes identifiable spoons with bowls and handles and knives in the right-hand block. Other tools include a grater and broad kitchen implements, without a visible eating-fork head or paired scissors. The coffee maker is not a microwave or oven; the wood cabinets are not a refrigerator, and the counter is not a dining table. Every frozen definition was considered on the original crop; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

Numerous actual people stand on the grass. Small flying shapes with kite bodies and flight/string context are visible across the sky, without identifiable actual birds or aircraft. A small bicycle with recognizable wheels and frame is visible near the right-side crowd. Background fabric and stalls do not supply identifiable umbrella structure or other defined objects; the trees have no pots. Every frozen definition was considered on the original crop; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

The large desktop display is a standalone monitor, with a separate computer keyboard and mouse on the desk. The small central black handheld device in its cradle has a display and controls but could be a PDA rather than a cellular handset, leaving cell phone category 67 unclear. The left device is a click-wheel music player, not a phone or remote. Small figures are miniatures rather than actual people or animals. The clipped circular monitor attachment lacks a time-of-day clock face, and the surface is a work desk. Every frozen definition was considered on the original crop.

The salad sits in a deep wooden bowl. Red-edged pale apple slices ring the rim, and finely shredded orange carrot forms a central pile. The pale wooden serving utensil at lower right has a spoon bowl and handle. Chickpeas, leafy greens, and shredded pale topping do not identify broccoli, orange fruit, or the other food categories. The patterned supporting surface suggests a cloth-covered eating table but its structure is not visible enough to exclude another surface, so dining table category 60 remains unclear. Every frozen definition was considered on the original crop.

Several actual zebras are identified by striped equid bodies and heads. The brown animal at right has a cattle head, horns, and body, identifying cow/cattle rather than a horse, sheep, bear, or elephant. The zebras do not count as horses under the frozen distinction. Grass and background trees are unpotted vegetation, and no people or defined manufactured objects are visible. Every frozen definition was considered across the original crop; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.
